criteria_results.text: Default global concurrency is 50 model-stream slots and is configurable.
criteria_results.notes: The live swarm admitted and completed all 50 real model turns; configuration behavior remains covered by the scheduler contract.

criteria_results.text: The scheduler is provider-agnostic and can apply provider-specific limits without serializing unrelated providers.
criteria_results.notes: Provider-specific separation is covered by deterministic scheduler tests; the live run used one provider.

criteria_results.text: A parent waiting for a child never retains capacity needed by that child.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by the Task parent-yield integration contract.

criteria_results.text: Capacity is released exactly once on success, error, cancellation, and abort.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by deterministic scheduler lifecycle contracts.

criteria_results.text: Provider throttling applies bounded cooldown/backpressure without globally blocking other providers.
Queued work is fair across roots so a large swarm cannot starve an interactive root.
criteria_results.notes: Covered by the root round-robin scheduler contract.

criteria_results.text: Cancelling a parent or child releases all associated scheduler capacity.
Scheduler diagnostics identify active and queued work and why a turn is waiting.
Unit tests cover flat concurrency, nested concurrency, cancellation, fairness, and provider-specific backpressure.
criteria_results.notes: Focused 41/41 and full fork session 392/392 checks passed.

criteria_results.text: A live behavioral test, gated behind an environment flag, dispatches a real 50-reader swarm through the engine/API surface and asserts that children actually enter model execution and complete or return results. Record the sandbox run in `docs/ai/runs/` per the repository verification gate.
criteria_results.notes: Branch-built engine/API returned READY-1164 from all 50 children in 22.60s; the exact length-50 assertion would fail on any missing child.

process_issues.description: A sandbox launched from a completed desktop exec cell was reaped despite nohup; the passing run kept a guardian exec session active and used the sandbox shutdown command.
process_issues.detected_by: Immediate health curl refusal plus missing PID/listeners after the launcher had printed ready.

process_issues.description: The initial live test expected catalog field providerId and preferred an engine-absent gpt-5-mini model; the real API uses provider and the built engine suggested gpt-5.4-mini.
process_issues.detected_by: Two fail-first live executions and direct inspection of the real catalog/provider endpoints.

process_issues.description: Parallel PR checks leaked auth/startup state across API files and the default five-second integration timeout was below the observed 5.03s startup tail. The coordinator merge gate now serializes API files and uses a 15s integration budget.
process_issues.detected_by: Different unrelated tests failed on consecutive parallel runs, passed alone, and the full serial 359-file/3179-test run passed.

suggested_follow_up: Keep the serialized API merge gate and alternate-port sandbox launcher in the final integration branch, and prefer real catalog/provider intersection in future live model tests.
